assumption: Use the virtual crystal approximation for Hg1-xCdxTe alloy band parameters
Use the Pidgeon-Brown 8x8 Gamma6-Gamma8-Gamma7 Landau-level Hamiltonian at kH=0
notes: Transition probabilities and energies are calculated numerically

assumption: Neglect inversion asymmetry and Gamma8 anisotropy in the principal Hamiltonian
notes: An observed Delta_n=-3 transition is instead noted as possibly induced by inversion asymmetry

assumption: Neglect Kane F and G matrix elements
Fix spin-orbit splitting Delta at 1 eV independent of composition
Infer epsilon0 from the zero-field convergence region of interband transition energies and fit remaining band parameters to transition series
notes: Epsilon0 is called directly obtained while Ep and Luttinger parameters are fitted

assumption: Neglect valence-band warping when quoting gamma and heavy-hole mass
notes: Authors identify this as the major source of uncertainty in gamma and m_h

assumption: Treat resonant-acceptor transitions as a separate evidence class from intrinsic interband transitions
notes: Impurity lines are identified by field dependence and broader linewidth
